wind.constraints: asset_type=stock; frequency=1d; adjustment=forward; maximum 60 calendar days

wind.reason: current binding is a real-time snapshot and cannot supply the required daily benchmark series

allowed_equivalents: target and benchmark daily series aligned by ISO trade date with forward adjustment and unchanged units
fallback_gate: daily benchmark series must come from another callable provider or session input; otherwise data_not_equivalent
beta: pre-event paired close returns only; no default value
enablement_gate: initially disabled; enable only after a successful macOS Wind comparison receipt is recorded
